{{Top|leg}}
'''Ganza eggs''' were a type of [[Egg/Legends|egg]] that could be consumed by [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. [[Freighter/Legends|Freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nyreen Vollen]] once delivered stocks of ganza eggs to [[Clan Skirata]]'s home on [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Kyrimorut]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
